text:
jamie: Opening 90m change window for feature flag llm_splitroute_v2. Ramp plan: 3% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100%. Cohorts: internal -> beta -> general. Will keep fallback pinned to model-route:v3.8 for 1h. Tagging @oncall and @sre. Release notes updated with rollback snippets.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by jamie at 2026-03-23T16:00:00Z. Actions queued:
 - ff set llm_splitroute_v2 pct=3 cohort=internal
 - deploy redwood/infer:v4.3.0 -> pool-prod-c
Health gates: p95_latency < 250ms, error_rate < 0.7%, token_efficiency delta < -3%. Auto-rollback triggers: error_rate > 1% sustained 60s OR p95 > 500ms for 2m.

liu: Request: pin fallback only for external traffic, internal teams should hit v4 for trace correlation. Use `ops pin-route --route llm --version v3.8 --scope external --ttl 1h`.

jamie: Good call, doing scoped pin now.

deploy-bot: Route llm pinned to v3.8 (scope=external ttl=1h) (3251110020).

rachel: I'll run a short smoke eval set on internal cohort and watch top1 rerank accuracy and token-per-response delta. Posting dashboard link.

nate: If KV eviction rate or cache misses jump, do immediate soft-throttle to 10% and notify infra. Rollback cmd: `/ff llm_splitroute_v2 0 "rollback - cache churn"`.

oncall: Acked; I'll monitor first 20m and escalate on threshold breaches.

deploy-bot: llm_splitroute_v2 set to 3% (3251110045). Canary traffic flowing.

jamie: 7m check: no error spike, tiny p95 bump +9ms. Holding at 3% to validate telemetry.

rachel: Smoke run #1: rerank delta 0.3%, token efficiency -0.5% (within gate). No cache anomalies observed.

deploy-bot: Rolling to 20% (3251110095).

liu: Observability: host-c shows transient cache-miss spike, looks like warm-up; trending down. Keeping an eye.

jamie: If it doesn't normalize in 4m reduce to 10%. Nate, stand by to throttle.

nate: ready. Throttle command: `/ff set llm_splitroute_v2 --pct 10 --note "throttle - observed cache spike"`

deploy-bot: llm_splitroute_v2 set to 60% (3251110130). Autoscaling kicked for pool-prod-c, no errors.

rachel: At 60%: p95 +18ms, error_rate 0.22%, token efficiency -1.8%. Cache-miss returning to baseline. Adding note to release notes about brief warmup.

jamie: Proceed to 100% now. Keep fallback pin active for 1h then auto-expire.

deploy-bot: llm_splitroute_v2 set to 100% (3251110160). image redwood/infer:v4.3.0 deployed to pool-prod-c. No auto-rollback triggered.

oncall: Observed a short tail-latency blip for ~90s at +12m but did not breach gates. Filing a follow-up ticket to trace tail latency cause.

nate: Added rollback + pin commands to the changelog so support knows the fallback route and how to revert quickly.

jamie: Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/llm_splitroute_v2-4.3.0 includes commands, scoped pin info, and the post-deploy checklist. Closing window; leaving external fallback pin for 1h. Thanks everyone. :rocket:

oncall: Acknowledged. Will hand off monitoring to rotation and file short "ramp playbook" doc referencing this thread.

rachel: Adding a nightly regression to catch small token-efficiency dips in subsequent runs.

jamie: Closing thread."
